subject: FY 2025 Collective Budget Recommendations
overview: The committee consolidated individual councilor requests into three collective priorities for the fiscal year 2025 budget and requested a financial analysis of Department of Public Works operations.

items.title: FY 2025 Collective Budget Recommendations
items.summary: Approved three collective budget recommendations for fiscal year 2025 focused on maintaining level service for schools and libraries, protecting grant-funded positions, increasing legal department salaries, and funding financial software upgrades or additional staffing.

items.title: DPW Cost Analysis and Signage Budget
items.summary: Requested a cost analysis from the DPW Commissioner comparing in-house paving operations to annual bonding costs and a proposed budget for road signage and striping to expedite repairs.
